purpose: Background extraction derivatives of user-provided artwork; original JPEGs remain unchanged.

prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied image only. This is user-provided artwork for a game sprite: preserve the exact existing character identity, face, expression, pose, clothing, colors, linework, texture, camera view, and existing crop. Remove only the external background and ground/cast shadow to a genuinely transparent alpha background. Preserve internal dark/white regions that belong to the subject and preserve fine edge details. Do not redesign, redraw, change style, invent anatomy, extend the image, add a body, add text, outline, glow, border, or a replacement background. Return one clean cutout with the entire supplied subject contained and a small transparent margin. Keep the entire orange cartoon creature, diaper, both hands, both feet, teeth and tongue exactly as in the reference. Remove the beige room and floor only.
